title: support
text:
support

maria (support): forwarding customer note — Acme says their 50-credit Dedicated promo landed on their Hosted tenant instead. They can open Hosted instances but Dedicated provisioning errors with `quota_exceeded`. Account: acme-342. Promo code: SUMMER_DED_50. Screenshot attached.
omar (billing): thanks. did the promo target a sku or an account tag? I need the original grant id if available. can you paste the raw payload the promo engine got?
maria (support): pasted payload from customer email: ```{
  account_id: "acme-342",
  promo_code: "SUMMER_DED_50",
  intended_product: "dedicated",
  applied_product: "hosted"
}``` they said applied_ts 2026-06-30T18:12:00Z.
omar (billing): checking internal ledger... do NOT run blanket reversals yet — need audit. tagging @alex for any routing hooks that might have mis-classified the promo.
alex (eng): I can look at the promo router. quick check: was there a fallback rule to Hosted if Dedicated capacity tag missing? that would explain automatic landing.
billing-bot: Ledger lookup complete — grant_id GRT-2026-06-30-44321, amount: 50 credits, applied_to: hosted_production:acme-342, created_by: promo-service, notes: "fallback: product_unavailable -> hosted".
omar (billing): got it — promo-service logged a fallback. we have two options: 1) transfer the 50 credits from hosted to dedicated on the same tenant, 2) void and reissue targeted to dedicated. preference is transfer to preserve timestamps.
maria (support): customer prefers minimal disruption — transfer is fine. they want confirmation once done.
alex (eng): root cause: promo-service misses dedicated-tag when tenant had no dedicated pool assigned; fallback rule applied. patch incoming to log more clearly. for now, omar, can you run the transfer? use `billing adjust-credit` with audit note.
omar (billing): running safe transfer: ```bash
billing-cli adjust-credit \--from hosted:acme-342 \--to dedicated:acme-342 \--amount 50 \--reason "promo fallback fix for GRT-2026-06-30-44321"
``` will attach audit id.
billing-bot: Transfer queued — tx_id TX-7721, status: pending.
omar (billing): tx_id TX-7721 completed. hosted balance decremented 50, dedicated balance incremented 50. audit: A-7721.
maria (support): pinging customer with confirmation and audit id.
leanne (cs): I'll send the follow-up note and check provisioning. also adding note to the customer record: promo routed wrong due to missing dedicated pool; CS to confirm no other tenants affected.
alex (eng): created bug: PROMO-487: promo-service fallback should flag admin and create a reissue task automatically. PR #1421 authored, targeting hotfix.
maria (support): customer replied: "Thanks — credits are now showing under Dedicated, we can provision. appreciate the quick help :heart:" closing on our side after CS confirms.
omar (billing): archived ledger note referencing Tx A-7721 and original grant GRT-2026-06-30-44321.
leanne (cs): confirmed provisioning worked. marking resolved and will follow up next week with patch status. :white_check_mark:
